soft.flops_estimate_scope: matmuls only; includes repeated soft Cell and router execution, excludes dispatch/norms/softmax
soft.activated_parameters_scope: mean unique executed Cell and router weights per token plus always-active backbone; repeated visits count in FLOPs
soft.benchmark_scope: FP16 no-grad forward on a resident batch; synchronization included, transfer/saving excluded

profile.scope: CUDA activity events, includes runtime kernels; excluded from timing

hard.flops_estimate_scope: matmuls only; includes repeated soft Cell and router execution, excludes dispatch/norms/softmax
hard.activated_parameters_scope: mean unique executed Cell and router weights per token plus always-active backbone; repeated visits count in FLOPs
hard.benchmark_scope: FP16 no-grad forward on a resident batch; synchronization included, transfer/saving excluded

profile.scope: CUDA activity events, includes runtime kernels; excluded from timing
